page.overview:
Who is Ayuu?

Ayuu was a male gergilla owned by the treasure hunter Lens Kamo. While attempting to escape the laboratory of Baron Yasto Attsmun, he was injured and captured by the baron. Attsmun used cybernetics to control Ayuu to attack Kamo and a droid repair technician, however they were able to free Ayuu from his cybernetic control.
